author: official
summary: Lets an owner change the words of a plain heading, paragraph or list item in a framed preview; posts a text-only edit to the host.

attributes.name: data-dynamic-coral
attributes.description: Selects the text-edit coral. One per page.

attributes.name: data-parent-origin
attributes.description: The only origin edits are posted to and answers are accepted from. No default: the coral does not mount without it.

attributes.name: data-page
attributes.description: The page path the host saves to. Absent: the frame's location.pathname.

attributes.name: data-hint-editor
attributes.description: The host's sentence for text that has formatting or structure (use the editor).

attributes.name: data-hint-refused
attributes.description: The host's sentence for a refused edit, when its answer carries none.

requirements: Renderer output inside a frame. Only `prose` sections (the renderer's `section.st-prose[id]`) are offered; every other section's text is component text and stays untouchable. The host applies edits with text-edit-source.mjs (or a port measured against it) and answers with `reef-text-edit-result`.
